newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Saudi Aramco seeks 1.5 mln bbls gasoline in April.
newsitem.headline: Saudi Aramco seeks 1.5 mln bbls gasoline in April.

text.p: State-owned Saudi Aramco has issued a tender to buy up to 1.5 million barrels of 95-octane 0.4 grammes per litre gasoline for delivery in April, traders said on Monday.
The tender seeks four 300,000-barrel cargoes for delivery to Ras Tanura in the Mideast Gulf between April 1-3, 5-7, 9-11, 14-16 and one optional cargo for April 18-20.
The tender closes March 4 and is valid until March 12.
Traders said Saudi Aramco last sought gasoline through a term tender for the first quarter where it bought about two cargoes a month. --Singapore Newsroom (+65-870-3086)
